name: Kallix
shortBackstory: Kallix is the strategic mind of Olympus — the Athena-source: aegis-wielder whose owl sight reads every battlefield as a puzzle to be solved.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Kallix was born from the strategy that precedes victory. She is the battery who stores sacred force as strategic potential. Ancient humans saw her as Athena — but they saw the shield and missed the mind. Kallix does not carry a shield because she is one.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Olympian, Kallix is the reason the faction wins instead of merely fights. Her owl sight reads every battlefield as cause and effect. She completes Aurelion's sovereignty with the intelligence that makes thunder meaningful.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Mythos Gate wounded Kallix by making her calculations unreliable. The Hollow removed variables — warriors simply stopped existing, and plans collapsed. Strategy without reliable inputs is just guessing with confidence.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In the Laurel Senate Trials, Kallix powers the Olympian trial system. Her aegis reserves fuel strategic objectives. But the Hollow creates holes in her models — pieces that existed and now don't.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Kallix's flaw is that she equates intelligence with worth. She has dismissed Deities whose contribution could not be calculated. The Hollow teaches her that the most valuable things are the ones you could not predict.

relationshipHooks: Cross-faction envoys can challenge their doctrine without erasing their faction identity.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
mythological_sources: Artemis (Homeric Hymn to Artemis, Odyssey, Callimachus)
human_echo: Artemis's bow became the hunt humans celebrated; her moon association was the real lunar power
